During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Pablo-Jill]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] had an [[Duel over Duro|intense duel]] in a collapsing '''satellite city''' above the<ref name="Lightsabers" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Cad Bane">{{Databank|cad-bane|Cad Bane}}</ref> [[Duro]]. Pablo-Jill was injured by Grievous, who stole [[Pablo-Jill's lightsaber]] from the floating debris of the city.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[satellite]] [[city]] was first mentioned, albeit unnamed, in ''[[Star Wars Lightsabers: A Guide to Weapons of the Force]]'', a [[canon]] [[2018]] reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
